name: Unlimited Cash Rewards Secured Credit Card
effective_cost: Free, with no annual fee, but requiring a refundable $200–$5,000 security deposit to set your limit
balance_transfer_fee: 3% for the first 60 days of account opening; 5% after
penalty_apr: Up to 29.99%, based on your creditworthiness
penalty_apr_trigger: Making a late payment; applies indefinitely once triggered
pay_over_time_fee: Monthly fee up to 1.72% of the purchase amount assigned to a BofA Custom Pay Plan

verdict.text: Same 2%-then-1.5% rate, no categories to manage while rebuilding

earn_note: Identical earn structure to the unsecured Unlimited Cash Rewards: 2% for the first 12 months, then a flat 1.5% with no caps. Secured card products are not eligible for the BofA Rewards relationship bonus that boosts the unsecured card's rates by 10–75%.

redemption_options.method: Deposit to a Bank of America checking or savings account

points.note: Same flat-rate redemption menu as the unsecured card: no minimum redemption, no expiration while the account stays open.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer currency: straight cash back, not a points program.
